# Secured Data, Safe interfaces

We at interface.ai take utmost care of your sensitive data with security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality and privacy.

Data security becomes the foremost concern when organizations engage with third-party vendors. We ensure the maximum protection of data for our partners and our assurance is acknowledged by the SOC 2 Attestation.

![Infographic of data security](https://interface.ai/_next/image?url=%2Flp%2Fdata-compliance%2Fdata-security.webp&w=828&q=75&dpl=dpl_7SxGrS45vF4fFWZRZ8Y3SLx57Chc)

![AICPA SOC logo](https://interface.ai/lp/data-compliance/aicpa-soc-logo.webp)

## We are proud to be accredited with SOC 2

SOC, the “System and Organization Controls”, has affirmed that interface.ai’s information security practices, policies, procedures, and operations meet the SOC 2 standards. We are dedicated to be at the highest level of security and compliance and we are striving to become more diligent to data security.

## SOC2 Attestation

The SOC2 Attestation of interface.ai addresses the third-party risk concerns by assessing policies, internal controls, and procedures that directly relate to the AICPA’s Trust Services Criteria. The Trust Services Criteria (TSC) has checked interface.ai on various parameters which were successfully validated by us. This prestigious certification has affirmed that interface.ai is a secured enterprise for businesses whose regulators, auditors, compliance officers, business partners, and executives require documented standards.

![interface.ai certificate explanation](https://interface.ai/lp/data-compliance/soc2-attestation.webp)

![AI letter with icons orbiting](https://interface.ai/lp/data-compliance/stay-protected.webp)

## Stay protected from data tempering and be a partner of interface.ai

Our experience in cutting-edge AI empowers you with developer-friendly, omnichannel AI assistants while keeping your data secured from unauthorized access. Be our partner and ensure the security of data.

![CSA STAR Level 1 badge](https://interface.ai/_next/image?url=%2Flp%2Fdata-compliance%2Fstar-level-1.webp&w=640&q=75&dpl=dpl_7SxGrS45vF4fFWZRZ8Y3SLx57Chc)

### We Achieved CSA STAR Level 1

We’re thrilled to announce that we’ve successfully achieved CSA STAR Level 1 compliance! This accomplishment demonstrates our commitment to rigorous cloud security practices as outlined by the Cloud Security Alliance (CSA).

![ISO 27001:2022 mark](https://interface.ai/_next/image?url=%2Flp%2Fdata-compliance%2Fiso-27001.webp&w=640&q=75&dpl=dpl_7SxGrS45vF4fFWZRZ8Y3SLx57Chc)

### We achieved ISO 27001:2022 certification

We are proud to announce that interface.ai has achieved ISO 27001:2022 certification, reaffirming our commitment to the highest standards of information security. This milestone reflects our dedication to safeguarding our clients’ data and maintaining robust security practices.

![CSA STAR Level 2 badge](https://interface.ai/_next/image?url=%2Flp%2Fdata-compliance%2Fstar-level-2.webp&w=640&q=75&dpl=dpl_7SxGrS45vF4fFWZRZ8Y3SLx57Chc)

### We achieved CSA STAR Level 2

We’re thrilled to announce our achievement of CSA STAR Level 2. At interface.ai, we take cloud security and compliance seriously. In our continuous commitment to trust and transparency, we’ve successfully completed our annual SOC 2 Type II audit with Cloud Security Alliance (CSA) Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) mapping and testing.
